# Brand My Mini Excavator

> Six brandable surfaces on a Bobcat E35 mini excavator on real job sites in Panama. Prices from $7,000 to $23,000, all public. One brand per industry, 12 months.

Funding goal: USD 85,000 — the real market price of the asset. Sell every surface and
the asset is bought outright. One brand per industry. Terms run 12 months.
Based in Panama. Updated August 2026.

## Sister sites (same operator, same rules, different asset)

- [HondaJet](https://brandmyprivatejet.com/)
- [Bobcat S570](https://brandmyskidsteer.com/)
- [Komatsu PC200](https://brandmyexcavator.com/)
